corrections.text: The headline and summary say Biome 2.6.2 adds Markdown, YAML and SCSS support and promotes 59 nursery rules. Biome's repository changelog lists these changes under version 2.6.0, published on npm on October 21; versions 2.6.1 and 2.6.2 followed the same day as patch releases. The 2.6.2 GitHub release page, which the article cites, carries the full list of 2.6 minor changes.
